Weekend Trip Ideas

A quick trip works best when the plan is simple enough to leave room for surprises. Two relaxed stops can feel fuller than a packed schedule.

Look for places within a short train ride or half-day drive. That keeps more time available for walking, coffee, and unplanned detours.

It helps to pick one indoor option and one outdoor option in case the weather shifts. A flexible outline makes the whole weekend feel lighter.
